text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: On the way back from shopping with Symboli Kris S—

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Step right up, the New Year's Grand Raffle is underway~!
The grand prize is an all-expenses-paid hot springs trip!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
1st prize is the "Special Carrot Hamburg Steak"!
2nd prize is "Mountain of Carrots"!
3rd prize is "Single Carrot"!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
"Step right up, step right up, it's the fun, fun lottery!
Anyone and everyone, come on over!"

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
............
A Japanese lottery――is it?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Come to think of it, when she bought the mineral water,
Symboli Kris S had received a lottery ticket.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer. ―I'm going to go draw.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
...I do not seek... results.
It is simply that—a ticket... has its own duty to fulfill.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
Today—in this place—
It was created... to be pulled.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ...I want to help them see it through to the end.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ――Well then.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Symboli Kris S spun the raffle wheel round and round.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And the result was—

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Incredible! Congraaaatulations!!
The Grand Prize, 'Hot Springs Trip Ticket', has been won~~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
...I won.
And what's more—a ticket for two.
choice_data_list: Why not invite someone along and take a breather?
Why not invite someone along and take a breather?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
"—No.
Right now, I don't—have room—for that."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
I'll let you have this, Trainer.
...Please, use it.
choice_data_list: Aren't you going to use it for them?
Aren't you going to let them use it?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ...I have... a mission—
choice_data_list: I'm sure the person who won the tickets would want you to use them!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
...Are you saying—that this is...
the true purpose—of this ticket?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
......
Then—would you—
hold onto this for me—for a little while?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ...Until the time comes—when I can.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "Someday, after fulfilling her duty—Symboli Kris S promised a well-deserved rest in the future."

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations, you won 1st prize~!
The prize is a "Special Carrot Hamburg Steak"!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
—Hamburg steak, huh.
When I was in my homeland—
I wasn't—very familiar with it.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
A burger... is a burger.
To me... it wasn't just a single item... but something meant to be sandwiched and eaten.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
Yet—coming to Japan—eating it—
I have—taken a liking to it.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
French friesâPastaâ
Saladâthe side dishes areâwonderful, too.
choice_data_list: Alright, let's buy some of those too!
Alright, let's buy some of those too!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
...Indeed.
Should I—partake—in its perfect form?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: Well then—we continue shopping, I take it.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And returning to the academy, the two of us
thoroughly enjoyed some hamburg steaks.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Second prize~!!
The prize is a "Mountain of Carrots"!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ...A mountain of food, huh—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
“—I'd like to eat it all, but—
for just me—it's slightly—too much.
............”

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
“—And that's why it's a donation, I see.
Thank you. I'll gladly accept it.”

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: —Yeah. I want this distributed—to the student council, and to any students in need.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
—That way... these carrots will feel
rewarded, too.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And after sharing with everyone,
we gratefully ate the leftover carrots.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
3rd prize~!
The prize is "one carrot"!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: One stick—huh.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: —I can't even... share it, can I?
choice_data_list: Eat as much as you like.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: —...I see.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: Well then—I shall take my nourishment.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Symboli Kris S gratefully
accepted the carrots.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Too bad, you lost!
Your consolation prize is a pack of tissues~

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
...Tissues are—an item—
with outstanding versatility.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: This, too... is a harvest.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
............
――I'd like to believe so.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: As expected, Symboli Kris S looked somewhat disappointed—
